in_marathi.name: Bheeti
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Beej or Seed
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bheeti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Bheeti is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Beej', which means 'Seed'. The name signifies the potential and power that lies within each individual, waiting to grow and flourish. It is also believed that the name carries the blessings of the gods, helping the bearer to overcome challenges and fulfill their destiny.
